task_completion.description: Log in to the application as Administrator.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Administrator user button being clicked or the main dashboard appearing with 'Administrator' logged in.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Stock management section and open the Products panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Stock' menu expanded and the 'Products' maintenance screen active.

task_completion.description: Enter the product name and barcode correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field should contain 'Tropicana Original Orange Juice' and the 'Barcode' (or Reference/EAN) field should contain '0048500202630'.

task_completion.description: Assign the product to the Beverages category and Standard Sales Tax category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Category' dropdown should show 'Beverages' and the 'Tax Category' dropdown should show 'Standard Sales Tax'.

task_completion.description: Set the buy price to $2.99 and sell price to $4.99.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Buy Price' field should show '2.99' and the 'Sell Price' (or Price Sell) field should show '4.99'.
The VLM should see the 'Save' (floppy disk icon) button being clicked, followed by a confirmation message or the fields clearing/resetting for a new entry.

integrity.description: The agent used the uniCenta oPOS graphical user interface rather than command-line database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with buttons and text fields within the uniCenta application window.

integrity.description: The agent did not use external scripts or pre-written macros to fill the form instantly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show sequential steps of data entry (typing or clicking) rather than the form being fully populated in a single frame.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual uniCenta oPOS software environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window decorations, icons, and menu structures must match the standard uniCenta oPOS interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: In uniCenta oPOS, the 'Products' screen is found under the 'Stock' menu. The 'Reference' and 'Barcode' fields are often used interchangeably for the EAN; the task specifies 0048500202630. The 'Save' button is typically represented by a floppy disk icon in the top toolbar of the product panel.
